ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent cases of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and track the money to uncover the scope of the problem.
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How are perpetrators able to commit fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on a critical issue affecting Minnesota's most vulnerable populations.
